title: Comparative machine learning and deep learning frameworks for robust carcinogenicity prediction and activity cliff analysis
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM01001B, Paper
Arkaprava Banerjee, Vinay Kumar, Kunal Roy
